bio: Experience vibrant Indian cuisine and classic British opulence with Cinnamon Kitchen's majestic Afternoon Tea in the historic Devonshire Square. Located in a former warehouse of the East India Trading Company in Devonshire Square, Cinnamon Kitchen London City is one of the most dynamic Afternoon Tea destinations in the heart of London.  Afternoon Tea at Cinnamon Kitchen London City is held on "The Terrace", bringing the perfect amalgamation of British late afternoon and Indian early evening tea. The all-weather terrace offers a unique opportunity to sit under the gorgeous blue skies of the capital, while enjoying some beautiful Afternoon Tea.  The menu features a delicious fusion of traditional British Afternoon Tea and gorgeously vibrant Indian cuisine. Cinnamon Kitchen London City offer a fine variety of Specialty Teas and freshly brewed in-house ginger and cardamom Indian Masala Chai. Guests may also enjoy delicious Indian Chaats, Hot Foods, and sumptuous Desserts. Cinnamon Kitchen also provide vegetarian alternatives, and a full allergen guide.  Cinnamon Kitchen London City is close to Liverpool Street Station.  A 12.5% discretionary service charge may be added to groups of 8 or more.
